description: Crop each image to several sizes at once, keeping the interesting part (or the centre). Sizes by name (square, instagram-square, portrait, instagram-portrait, portrait-34, story, landscape, x-post, linkedin, og, link-preview, pinterest, banner, dribbble), as an aspect ratio like "4:5" (the largest crop of that shape, at the image’s own resolution), or as {name, width, height}. Saved next to the originals as name-<size>.ext. [Pro tool.]

crop.description: What each crop keeps: "attention" the most eye-catching part (faces, colour, contrast), "centre" the middle, "entropy" the most detailed part.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: Output format. "original" keeps each file’s own (HEIC, AVIF and TIFF become JPEG).

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

sizes.description: The crops: size names, ratios like "16:9", or {name, width, height}. Default: square, portrait 4:5 and portrait 3:4.

name.description: Short name used in the file name.

name: multi_crop
title: Multi crop
